model.gpu: single T4 (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0); a second T4, if allocated, is unused

decoding.rationale: greedy, matching the historical NR/SR runs; 200-token intermediate steps like the SequentialReason thoughts, 64-token final answer like NR/SR

deviations: whitespace-only lines are dropped (they cannot be sub-questions); counted per row
if no non-blank line remains, the original question is used as the single sub-question, flagged fallback=true (the DR call flow still runs: 3 calls)
lib.chat strips leading/trailing whitespace of every engine response, as in the historical NR/SR runs
kept_as_upstream: sub-questions are the first decompose_num non-blank lines in order
numbering and other prefixes are kept verbatim
no dedup, no repair, no truncation of long lines
Solve and Merge state formatting: '%d. %s (Answer: %s)' / '(Current Sub-question)' lines joined with newline
Merge retrieval key: the answered current_state string

run.seed_policy: greedy decoding, so no sampling seed; seed 0 fixes only the deterministic smoke-key selection and ordering (slice order otherwise)

smoke.reason: same frozen settings as the full run, so the full run resumes them instead of repeating calls

baseline_sanity.source: results/t4/s1 NaiveReason rows restricted to the 306-key slice, recomputed in this job with the same deployment
baseline_sanity.rationale: detects unexplained deployment drift (model revision, engine, templates, retrieval) before the full run; the exact-response floor is 3/6 on the historical vLLM 0.32.0 and 2/6 on any other engine because greedy text can differ by a token on a different build, while the retrieval-overlap floor stays 5/6 (retrieval does not depend on the engine)

deadline.reason: shared account has 30 GPU-hours per refresh (verified: timedelta 1 day 6 h, 0 used) and the two workers still serialize on the GPU lock, so this job is pushed with --timeout 9000 (2.5 h) after MR's 3 h and stops submitting 1200 s before the hard kill, leaving time for Kaggle to persist/commit /kaggle/working

scoring.leak_free_rule: slice flag leak_any == false (no number shared with own gold statements)
